deadline.value: PhD applications are due December 1 and are given priority for admission and funding.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for PhD applicants is December 1.

fee_waiver.value: A limited number of fee waivers are available; request by November 9.
fee_waiver.quote: A limited number of application fee waivers are available.

also.quote: Please complete this application fee waiver request form no later than November 9 to submit your request.

gre_general.value: Do not submit GRE scores; they are not used.
gre_general.quote: Applicants should not submit GRE scores. These scores will not be used as part of the admission process.

entry_route.value: A master's is not required; several students joined the PhD straight from their undergraduate degrees.
entry_route.quote: Several of our current students joined the PhD program directly after finishing their undergraduate degrees.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study
